summary: The Iceberg community is actively discussing various enhancements and proposals, including the introduction of a first-class Tag concept in the REST Catalog and the addition of an OpenTelemetry MetricsReporter. Recent discussions also focus on clarifying the Avro schema for partition transforms and improving metadata representation for column updates.
highlights: Discussion on ambiguity in Avro schema for 'day' partition transform
Proposal for first-class Tag concept in Iceberg REST Catalog
Introduction of X-Iceberg-Client-Capabilities header to REST spec
Discussion on metadata representation for column updates
